job.description:
Our client, a prestige beauty brand, is seeking a hands-on, detail-oriented Quality Manager to oversee daily Quality Assurance and Quality Control operations at its manufacturing facility in the Piedmont Triad metropolitan area in North Carolina. This is a full-time, onsite opportunity requiring five days per week in the facility.

The ideal candidate has QA/QC experience within a cosmetics, chemical, pharmaceutical, biotech, or related regulated manufacturing environment, with a strong understanding of GMP compliance, quality systems, and analytical laboratory testing. Experience with HPLC is particularly valuable. This role will oversee quality processes, product testing and release, investigations, audits, and continuous improvement initiatives while partnering closely with internal manufacturing, R&D, and corporate quality teams to maintain product quality and regulatory compliance.

Job Duties:

  • Oversee all daily Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) operations, including product release testing, scheduling, incoming material inspections, Nonconforming Material Reports (NCMRs), and corrective action activities.

  • Partner with the VP of Manufacturing Operations at Virtue Labs to plan and execute short-, mid-, and long-term quality objectives, focusing on product quality, continuous improvement, and regulatory compliance.

  • Develop and execute Quality Management Plans for new product development initiatives and quality improvement projects.

  • Maintain a clean and safe work environment by identifying potential hazards and recommending corrective actions as needed.

  • Follow proper lifting and material-handling techniques and promptly report work-related injuries to Human Resources.

  • Maintain a cooperative, professional, and collaborative working relationship with co-workers, supervisors, and external stakeholders.

  • Read, understand, and follow all applicable Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Manufacturing Instructions (MIs), and Quality Instructions (QIs) for assigned functions.

  • Experience with IQ/OQ/PQ, root cause analysis, statistical methods, and Design of Experiments (DOE).

  • Knowledge of and hands-on experience with Nonconforming Material Reports (NCMR) and Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) processes.

  • Knowledge of and experience with AQL and statistical sampling methods.
